mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the auth-required fact lets Alloy invent an Operation with no caller but outcome Accepted, which is exactly what FR-001 and the AuthRequiredEverywhere pattern forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuthViolation { some op: Operation | op.outcome = Accepted and no op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the append-only constraint on task_deletions lets two TaskDeletion rows reference the same Task, violating the permanence/append-only guarantee.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj td1, td2: TaskDeletion | td1.deletedTaskRef = td2.deletedTaskRef }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the produces-deletion fact lets an accepted DELETE happen without writing a task_deletions row, which is the exact audit-completeness failure mode for FR-018.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = DeleteOp and op.outcome = Accepted and no op.producedDeletion }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the deletion-attribution fact lets the deletion row record a deleter that is not the calling user, which the AttributionCorrectness pattern explicitly forbids.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AttributionViolation { some op: Operation, td: TaskDeletion | op.producedDeletion = td and td.deletedBy != op.caller }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the closed-task-edit rule lets Alloy accept a PATCH on a done task that does not simultaneously reopen it, which FR-011 (and US2 #5/#6) forbid.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ClosedTaskViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = EditOp and op.outcome = Accepted and some op.target and op.target.status = Done and no op.setsStatusTo }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing the validation-before-mutation fact lets a rejected CreateOp still produce a Task row, which violates the atomicity contract in data-model.md and the validation gate for FR-005..FR-008.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_ValidationViolation { some op: Operation | op.kind = CreateOp and op.outcome != Accepted and some op.produced }
